title: Read a path value
summary: Phoenix: Read a path value. Visit /hello/Asha.
introduction: A colon marks a router input. Pattern matching reads its string-keyed parameter. Open GET /hello/Ravi.
learningObjectives: Read a path value with Phoenix

blocks.text: Create an app named school with mix phx.new school --no-ecto --no-html --no-assets. Enter school and run mix deps.get. Put each labelled section in its named file, then run mix phx.server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4000.

blocks.title: Read a path value
blocks.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/hello/:name", LessonController, :hello
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def hello(conn, %{"name" => name}), do: text(conn, "Hi, #{name}!")
end

blocks.text: The pattern reads the string key name from params. It binds Ravi for interpolation.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: HTTP parameter keys are strings, not atoms.
